defineModel for Tag and the post_tags join model
route body contract: a zod field on PostPayloadSchema (string → transform → pipe(array)) so an invalid tag list gets the same 422 as an invalid title

harness_signal: The baseline has no tagging at all: two tables, a migration, a model with a many-to-many relationship, a validator change, four controller actions, the resource and four pages all move. The ORM's belongsToMany reads through a pivot but has no attach/sync, so writing the pivot takes a join model (defineModel on post_tags) or hand-written inserts; the filter needs the pivot too (whereIn on the ids the tag carries). Two type-level traps: the Edit page's Props type derives from the route body (a string field), which no longer fits a resource whose tags are string[], and codegen types the form body from the schema's input side, so a transform in the schema keeps the form typed as a string. The same-as-title failure is free when the rule lives on the route's body schema (422 with errors.tags) and costs a hand-built 422 otherwise. `guren context` lists belongsToMany, whenLoaded and paginate; the shipped+plan condition hands the agent the approved plan's steps.

plan_authoring.notes: Written by an Opus authoring subagent inside its task-authoring session. Minutes: 3 measured (first write of plan.json through plan:render x3, plan:approve and the harness-shaped plan:next check) + ~8 estimated for reading the implementation-plans guide, plan/schema.ts and plan/tasks.ts (task derivation) first. Tokens: ~70k of context consumed over the same span (reading + writing), read off the session counter. Render iterations: a form must list every validator field (so the altered PostPayloadSchema lists title/excerpt/body too), and each altered action (show, edit) needs a behaviour naming its route (AC-post-tags-7/8, plan-only). Intent entity is PostTag, not Post: an added table anchors its own task, and post_tags' FK to posts would otherwise order the pivot's task after the task holding the behaviours. Derived order: Tag (scaffold, data) then PostTag (scaffold, tests, data, http, pages); the scaffold steps complete on codegen+typecheck alone.
